title: Silent Film
look: A 1920s reel: silver greys with a sepia tint, grain and scratches, a dark vignette, flicker, 16 fps.

doc.essence: A frame of silent-era film projected a century later: soft orthochromatic greys toned warm, dust and scratches on the print, the corners burned dark, the light pulsing and the motion a little jerky.
doc.notIt: Not rubber-hose (no fat black line, no sepia paper: silver greys, a vignette and scratches, no bounce), not pencil (projected light, not graphite), not one-bit (continuous greys).
doc.shapes: A thin dark grey contour; areas softly lit from the upper left.
doc.colour: Every colour becomes a silver grey of the same lightness, tinted warm.
doc.motion: Steps at 16 fps, the old hand-cranked rate, with an uneven projector flicker.
pitfalls: Flicker must stay gentle (no more than 15 %) and never strobe.
The vignette sits over the character: keep its centre fully clear.
